artifacts: JSON envelope with classified conjunctions, domain scatter entropy and density (stdout or --out)

purpose: AIC-8 prestige-metaphor detector. Builds on image-conjunction detection ("the architecture of grief"), classifies each conjunction's scaffolding word into a semantic domain, and flags documents whose conjunctions scatter across many prestige domains (metaphor confetti) rather than concentrating around one thematic commitment.
use_when: essayistic or literary prose leans on "the X of Y" image conjunctions and you want to know whether they cohere or scatter
